title: Scalar compatibility of the smooth purity pullback exchange
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p^a}$ as in [def-pur-conventions]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, and use the rational constructible categories $\mathcal C_E(W)=D^b_c(W,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], the twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], the derived pullbacks and exceptional inverse images of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and the exact scalar extensions $T_W=T_{L/E,W}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Write $G_{h,E}=Rh_E^!$ and $H_{h,E}=Lh_E^*(-)(d_h)[2d_h]$ for a smooth separated $h$ of pure relative dimension $d_h$. Let $\gamma_{h,E}:H_{h,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{h,E}$ be the rationalization of the simultaneous integral purity family of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], as in [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity]. Denote by $b_{h,K}:T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}G_{h,E}K\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{h,L}T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}K$ the rationalized counit-normalized comparison specified in that integral scalar-naturality statement.

Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}X'&\xrightarrow{u}&X\\ f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{v}&Y\end{array}$$
be a Cartesian square of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with $f$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$, $v$ an arbitrary $k$-morphism, and $K\in\mathcal C_E(Y)$. Then $f'$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d$ by [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence] and separated of finite type by [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change]. Use the scalar pullback comparisons
$$p_{h,M}:T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}Lh_E^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_L^*T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}M$$
of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. For $R=E,L$, let $\operatorname{Ex}_R^{!,\mathrm{sm}}:Lu_R^*G_{f,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{f',R}Lv_R^*$ be the smooth exchange obtained by integral reconstruction and rationalization of the purity composite of [def-pur-smooth-pullback-exchange], as specified in [def-pur-conventions, prop-pur-adic-reconstruction-trace-coherence]. Define
$$\beta_{A,K}=Lu_L^*(b_{f,K})\circ p_{u,G_{f,E}K}:T_{X'}Lu_E^*G_{f,E}K\longrightarrow Lu_L^*G_{f,L}T_YK,$$
$$\beta_{B,K}=G_{f',L}(p_{v,K})\circ b_{f',Lv_E^*K}:T_{X'}G_{f',E}Lv_E^*K\longrightarrow G_{f',L}Lv_L^*T_YK.$$
Then the actual smooth exchange satisfies the scalar equation
$$\beta_{B,K}\circ T_{X'}(\operatorname{Ex}_{E,K}^{!,\mathrm{sm}})=\operatorname{Ex}_{L,T_YK}^{!,\mathrm{sm}}\circ\beta_{A,K}.$$
This is an equality of natural transformations in $K$, with the unit, successive coefficient-extension and shift identifications specified by the scalar comparisons above.
